pose: A wide shot showcasing the expansive prehistoric environment. The frame captures a vast landscape of the forest understory filled with dense fern foliage, low-lying shrubs, and fallen logs. In the middle ground, the smaller juvenile sauropod is resting, but it is heavily obscured by the surrounding layers of foliage and its natural countershading, rendering it barely visible from this distance. Further away, the larger feathered dinosaur is a small figure walking through the background trees, entirely oblivious to the hidden creature.
